changelog:
## v1.9.31

- Unified Single Widget Architecture: Removed duplicate bundle widget registration so only ONE clean widget appears in Elementor panel with Single vs Multi-Product mode switcher
- Multi-Product Layouts: Added Grid Cards, Horizontal List Row, and Compact Table layouts with responsive styling
- Full Element Customization: Added Elementor style controls for cards, thumbnails, titles, prices, variation swatches, quantity steppers, select buttons, and summary bar
- Instant AJAX Sync: Checkout order review updates instantly upon product selection, variation switch, or quantity change
